market_half.verdict: NO route-class market exists — the model's 9.3% uncertainty reduction on route class is information on a margin the market does not price. That is the literal 'depth the market cannot match', measured. Game-margin comparison vs Kalshi spread requires per-play win-prob rollouts (documented blocker: counterfactual engine, assumption 6).

measured_conclusion.calibration_half: RAN on real data: 2,521 held-out plays, week-split, context prior top-1 16.7% (2x uniform), Brier 0.8852 (12-class), reliability within ~1.2pp of stated in the dense bin. Tracking feature (separation at pass arrival, train-side LR) improves held-out log-score by 0.0059 — POSITIVE but small: the single feature earns a nonzero but modest weight at this blend. The founder's demanded before/after exists with real numbers.
measured_conclusion.next_lever: the feature set is ONE variable; BDB tracking supports separation-over-time, speed-at-break, alignment leverage — the LR generalizes to a feature FAMILY; expected to multiply the delta.
